description: Test script to verify that a fuzzer produces deterministic output with the same seed by running the fuzzer multiple times and comparing outputs.

methods.name: run_fuzzer_with_seed
methods.description: Runs the fuzzer with a specified seed, captures and returns the generated source code or program source from stdout or file.

methods.name: test_deterministic_output
methods.description: Runs the fuzzer multiple times with the same seed and checks if all outputs are identical, indicating determinism.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that executes the determinism test and exits with success or failure status.
